A '''ceremonial table''' was a table used in religious ceremonies by the residents of [[Kerritamba Village]] in the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. It was the first piece of the "[[Great Tree (Kashyyyk)|Nyenthi'Oris]] Gifts" collection along with a [[ceremonial chair]] and a [[mystical centerpiece]].

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ceremonial tables first appeared in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online role-playing game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
